# Mohanad Abubaker — Personal Portfolio

> Personal portfolio of Mohanad Abubaker Abdullah Abdelgalli — a Grade 12 STEM innovator in AI, robotics and IoT from Sudan, studying in the UAE, FIRST Global Gold Medalist with Team Sudan and official ICSC Ambassador.

The site showcases his background, skills, projects, achievements, certificates and contact details.

## Pages

- [Home](/): About Mohanad, skills, featured projects, achievements, certificates and contact info.
- [Agri-Shield 4.0](/projects/agri-shield): Solar-powered ESP32 IoT system that protects grain silos against spoilage and theft, with an interactive 3D model of the silo.
- [AFAQ](/projects/afaq): AI learning platform built around the UAE and Arab school curriculum.
- [NOVA City](/projects/nova-city): Hybrid renewable energy, water and food city concept for Sudan, inspired by UAE projects.
- [Team Sudan Robot](/projects/team-sudan-robot): Interactive 3D model of Team Sudan's FIRST Global Challenge robot and the team's Gold Medal award.
- [Smart Greenhouse Guide](/projects/smart-greenhouse): Technical walkthrough for an Arduino/ESP32 + DHT22 smart greenhouse with MQTT.
